brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Tropical Wave No. 47 and a trough are increasing rainfall across Costa Rica, with the CNE reporting severe downpours in Cartago, Heredia, and Alajuela. [4]
A fire forced the Costa Rica Imax Theater to close indefinitely, leaving one Imax theater in the country. [2]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR COSTA RICA
The severe downpours from Tropical Wave No. 47 may strain Costa Rica's infrastructure, given the country's net energy import dependency of 60%. [4][E3]

KEY RISKS
Costa Rica's 60% net energy import dependency creates a risk of energy supply disruptions during extreme weather events. [E3]

WATCH ITEMS
The indefinite closure of the Costa Rica Imax Theater after a fire leaves one Imax theater in the country, with no announced reopening date. [2]
